Located deep within the jungles of [[Revyia]] was a '''smuggler base'''. The base was [[Skirmish on Revyia|eliminated]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], leading to the establishment of an [[Revyia Imperial base|Imperial base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
